category_edits.rationale: Test whether increasing pointwise supervision from 0.2 to 0.3 improves ranking across all four datasets while retaining BPR and valid-position averaging. This changes only the loss coefficient; architecture, inference, sampling and training settings remain consistent.

response.change_summary: Increase only the shared pointwise-loss coefficient from 0.2 to 0.3. Retain one GRU4Rec model per dataset; no predictor changes are required.
